description: Îlots de chaleur is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Polygones représentant les îlots de chaleur à la surface du sol. Un îlot de chaleur est défini par l’écart de température observé entre deux milieux environnants à un même moment. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Chaleur, Changement climatique, Environnement, PoleARTM, Résilience. It offers 18 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOTIFF, SHP, WEB. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
